mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 20-day periods following months with FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.2pp rise in one month) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate hiring and consumer spending weaken.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 5-day periods following a 1-month UNRATE increase >0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in one month indicate a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 60-day periods following simultaneous HOUST and RSAFS declines >1% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 110) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate output growth decelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following INDPRO < 110 in late-cycle expansion regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL growth > 0.3pp in one month) signals an imminent monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 5-day periods following a 1-month CPIAUCSL increase >0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A positive growth rate in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals robust supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate output and profits increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the 60-day periods following months with INDPRO growth rate > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST falls > 1.0% in one month) signals weakening residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 5-day periods following a 1-month HOUST decline >1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation and low interest rate regime (CPIAUCSL growth > 3.0% annually and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%), the S&P 500 tends to decline over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve.
regime_hint: high inflation and low interest rate regime
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following the regime condition (CPIAUCSL growth > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%).
